text.en: Hokkaido Ainu employs a range of noun prefixes and suffixes to modify or extend nominal meaning. Certain nouns express the feminine by prefixing *mat-*, as in *ainu* 'man' versus *matainu* 'woman', *karku* 'nephew' versus *matkarku* 'niece', *ak* 'younger brother' versus *matak* 'younger sister', and *hekachi* 'boy' versus *matkachi* 'girl' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--certain-nouns-express-the-feminine-by-prefixing-mat⟧. In personal names and names of deities, *-kur* serves as a male marker and *-mat* as a female marker ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--in-personal-names-and-names-of-deities-kur⟧. Noun prefixes are predominantly directional, forming pairs such as *e-*/*o-* and *he-*/*ho-* to denote direction towards and direction away from something ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--noun-prefixes-are-predominantly-directional-prefixes-forming-pairs⟧; Refsing analyzes *he-* 'towards' and *ho-* 'away from' as noun prefixes in Shizunai Ainu ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-directional-prefixes-he-towards-and-ho-away⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-directional-prefixes-he-towards-and-ho-away-2⟧. The prefix *si-* attaches to nouns as well as stative verbs with the meaning 'genuine' or 'original' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-si-attaches-to-nouns-and-verbals⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-si-may-be-used-with-nouns⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-si-may-also-be-prefixed-to⟧; Kindaichi and Chiri similarly record *shi-* as meaning 'real/true' or 'great' and as marking the reflexive ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-shi-can-mean-real-true-great⟧. The prefix *ar-* conveys 'one' or 'half/one of a pair' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ar-can-mean-one-or-half⟧, and also 'opposite' or, as an intensive, 'completely' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ar-can-mean-opposite-or-function⟧; Satō additionally notes that *ar-* can mean 'one side of a pair' or 'one out of multiple items' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ar-also-conveys-the-meaning-of⟧. The prefixes *ear-* and *oar-* correspond to *ar-* in its senses of 'one', 'half', and intensive 'completely' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ear-is-equivalent-to-ar-in⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-oar-is-equivalent-to-ar-in⟧. The prefix *am-* attaches to words denoting planar objects to add the nuance of 'broad' or 'spacious' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-am-attaches-to-words-denoting-planar⟧. The prefix *ir-* expresses continuity, simultaneous unison, or being in a row ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ir-expresses-continuity-simultaneous-unison-or⟧. The prefix *kan-* denotes 'upper part' or 'surface' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-kan-denotes-upper-part-or-surface⟧. The prefix *no-* serves as a eulogistic or honorific prefix ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-no-serves-as-a-eulogistic-or⟧. The prefix *pi-* expresses 'minute' or 'tiny/slight' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-pi-expresses-minute-or-tiny-slight⟧. The prefix *ru-* denotes 'half' or 'incomplete' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ru-denotes-half-or-incomplete⟧. The prefix *san-* denotes projecting parts or things that stick out ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-san-denotes-projecting-parts-or-things⟧. The prefix *sem-* functions as a privative prefix ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-sem-functions-as-a-privative-prefix⟧ and is also used pejoratively or as an expletive to express emotion ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-sem-is-used-pejoratively-or-as⟧. The suffix *-ke* can attach to words other than locative nouns, converting nouns of abstract meaning into expressions referring to concrete entities ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-suffix-ke-can-attach-to-words-other⟧. Under a narrow definition excluding verb formatives and postpositions, Shizunai Ainu has three noun suffixes: *-ke*, *-po*, and *-utar* ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--noun-suffixes-consist-of-only-three-morphemes-two⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--under-a-narrow-definition-excluding-verb-formatives-and⟧. The Hokkaido Ainu noun *húnpe* 'whale' is analyzed as an innovation consisting of the onomatopoeia *hún* and *pe* 'thing' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--hokkaido-ainu-h-npe-whale-is-an-innovation⟧.
text.ja: 北海道アイヌ語は、名詞の意味を修飾・拡張するために多様な名詞接頭辞および接尾辞を用いる。若干の名詞は*mat-*を冠して女性を表示し、*ainu*「男」対*matainu*「女」、*karku*「甥」対*matkarku*「姪」、*ak*「弟」対*matak*「妹」、*hekachi*「男の子」対*matkachi*「女の子」のような対が形成される⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--certain-nouns-express-the-feminine-by-prefixing-mat⟧。人名や神名においては、*-kur*が男性の標識、*-mat*が女性の標識として用いられる⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--in-personal-names-and-names-of-deities-kur⟧。名詞接頭辞は主に方向接頭辞であり、*e-*/*o-*や*he-*/*ho-*のように対をなして対象へ向かう方向と離れる方向を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--noun-prefixes-are-predominantly-directional-prefixes-forming-pairs⟧；RefsIngは静内アイヌ語において*he-*「〜へ向かって」および*ho-*「〜から離れて」を名詞接頭辞として分析する⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-directional-prefixes-he-towards-and-ho-away⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-directional-prefixes-he-towards-and-ho-away-2⟧。接頭辞*si-*は状態動詞だけでなく名詞にも付加して「本物の」「元の」という意味を付与する⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-si-attaches-to-nouns-and-verbals⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-si-may-be-used-with-nouns⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-si-may-also-be-prefixed-to⟧；金田一・知里も同様に*shi-*を「本当の」「真の」「大なる」の意味および再帰相の標識として記録している⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-shi-can-mean-real-true-great⟧。接頭辞*ar-*には「一」あるいは「半」「片」の意味があり⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ar-can-mean-one-or-half⟧、また「反対側の」あるいは強調として「全く」の意味もある⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ar-can-mean-opposite-or-function⟧；佐藤はさらに*ar-*が「片方」や「複数あるものの一つ」を意味しうると指摘する⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ar-also-conveys-the-meaning-of⟧。接頭辞*ear-*および*oar-*は、*ar-*の「一」「半」「全く」の意味に対応する⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ear-is-equivalent-to-ar-in⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-oar-is-equivalent-to-ar-in⟧。接頭辞*am-*は平面状の物に付いて「ひろやかな」という気持ちを添える⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-am-attaches-to-words-denoting-planar⟧。接頭辞*ir-*は「ひとつゞき」の意味を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ir-expresses-continuity-simultaneous-unison-or⟧。接頭辞*kan-*は「上部・表面」を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-kan-denotes-upper-part-or-surface⟧。接頭辞*no-*は「美称」として用いられる⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-no-serves-as-a-eulogistic-or⟧。接頭辞*pi-*は「微」「小」を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-pi-expresses-minute-or-tiny-slight⟧。接頭辞*ru-*は「半」を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ru-denotes-half-or-incomplete⟧。接頭辞*san-*は「出ているもの」を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-san-denotes-projecting-parts-or-things⟧。接頭辞*sem-*は否定的・欠如の意味を表し⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-sem-functions-as-a-privative-prefix⟧、悪罵あるいは感情の強調としても用いられる⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-sem-is-used-pejoratively-or-as⟧。接尾辞*-ke*は位置名詞以外にも付き、抽象的な意味の名詞類を具体的な意味を指すものにする機能を持つ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-suffix-ke-can-attach-to-words-other⟧。動詞形成形態素や後置詞を除外した狭義の定義では、静内アイヌ語の名詞接尾辞は*-ke*、*-po*、*-utar*の3つである⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--noun-suffixes-consist-of-only-three-morphemes-two⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--under-a-narrow-definition-excluding-verb-formatives-and⟧。北海道アイヌ語の*húnpe*「鯨」は、擬音語*hún*と*pe*「もの」からなる新語と分析される⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--hokkaido-ainu-h-npe-whale-is-an-innovation⟧。

text.en: The diminutive suffix *-po* attaches to nouns to derive nouns meaning 'small X', as in *cep-po* / *cheppo* ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--diminutive-suffix-po-derives-small-noun⟧. The suffix *-po* also functions as an affectionate or familiar suffix in kinship terms, forming *achipo* 'father/dad', *hapo* 'mother/mom', *yupo* 'older brother', and *kakapo* 'older sister' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-suffix-po-functions-as-an-affectionate-or⟧.
text.ja: 指小接尾辞*-po*は名詞に付いて「小さい〜」を意味する名詞を派生し、*cep-po* / *cheppo*などの形が見られる⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--diminutive-suffix-po-derives-small-noun⟧。接尾辞*-po*はまた親愛を表す愛称または親称としても機能し、*achipo*「父さん」、*hapo*「母さん」、*yupo*「兄さん」、*kakapo*「姉さん」などを形成する⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-suffix-po-functions-as-an-affectionate-or⟧。

text.en: Under a narrow definition excluding verb formatives and postpositions, Shizunai Ainu has three noun suffixes: *-ke*, *-po*, and *-utar*, all serving to extend or modify the meaning of the host noun ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--noun-suffixes-consist-of-only-three-morphemes-two⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--under-a-narrow-definition-excluding-verb-formatives-and⟧. The suffix *-ke* can attach to words other than locative nouns, functioning to convert nouns of abstract meaning into expressions referring to concrete entities ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-suffix-ke-can-attach-to-words-other⟧. The prefix *am-* attaches to words denoting planar objects to add the nuance of 'broad' or 'spacious' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-am-attaches-to-words-denoting-planar⟧. The prefix *ar-* can mean 'one' or 'half/one of a pair' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ar-can-mean-one-or-half⟧, and also 'opposite' or, as an intensive, 'completely' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ar-can-mean-opposite-or-function⟧; the prefixes *ear-* and *oar-* correspond to *ar-* in these same senses ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ear-is-equivalent-to-ar-in⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-oar-is-equivalent-to-ar-in⟧. The prefix *ir-* expresses continuity, simultaneous unison, or being in a row ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ir-expresses-continuity-simultaneous-unison-or⟧. The prefix *kan-* denotes 'upper part' or 'surface' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-kan-denotes-upper-part-or-surface⟧. The prefix *no-* serves as a eulogistic or honorific prefix ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-no-serves-as-a-eulogistic-or⟧. The prefix *pi-* expresses 'minute' or 'tiny/slight' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-pi-expresses-minute-or-tiny-slight⟧. The prefix *ru-* denotes 'half' or 'incomplete' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ru-denotes-half-or-incomplete⟧. The prefix *san-* denotes projecting parts or things that stick out ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-san-denotes-projecting-parts-or-things⟧. The prefix *sem-* functions as a privative prefix ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-sem-functions-as-a-privative-prefix⟧ and is also used pejoratively or as an expletive to express emotion ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-sem-is-used-pejoratively-or-as⟧. The prefix *shi-* can mean 'real/true' or 'great', and also marks the reflexive ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-shi-can-mean-real-true-great⟧.
text.ja: 動詞形成形態素や後置詞を除外した狭義の定義では、静内アイヌ語の名詞接尾辞は*-ke*、*-po*、*-utar*の3つであり、いずれも先行する形式の意味を拡張または修飾する働きをする⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--noun-suffixes-consist-of-only-three-morphemes-two⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--under-a-narrow-definition-excluding-verb-formatives-and⟧。接尾辞*-ke*は位置名詞以外にも付き、抽象的な意味の名詞類を具体的な意味を指すものにする機能を持つ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-suffix-ke-can-attach-to-words-other⟧。接頭辞*am-*は平面状の物に付いて「ひろやかな」という気持ちを添える⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-am-attaches-to-words-denoting-planar⟧。接頭辞*ar-*には「一」あるいは「半」「片」の意味があり⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ar-can-mean-one-or-half⟧、また「反対側の」あるいは強調として「全く」の意味もある⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ar-can-mean-opposite-or-function⟧；接頭辞*ear-*および*oar-*はこれらと同じ意味において*ar-*に対応する⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ear-is-equivalent-to-ar-in⟧⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-oar-is-equivalent-to-ar-in⟧。接頭辞*ir-*は「ひとつゞき」の意味を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ir-expresses-continuity-simultaneous-unison-or⟧。接頭辞*kan-*は「上部・表面」を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-kan-denotes-upper-part-or-surface⟧。接頭辞*no-*は「美称」として用いられる⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-no-serves-as-a-eulogistic-or⟧。接頭辞*pi-*は「微」「小」を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-pi-expresses-minute-or-tiny-slight⟧。接頭辞*ru-*は「半」を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-ru-denotes-half-or-incomplete⟧。接頭辞*san-*は「出ているもの」を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-san-denotes-projecting-parts-or-things⟧。接頭辞*sem-*は否定的・欠如の意味を表し⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-sem-functions-as-a-privative-prefix⟧、悪罵あるいは感情の強調としても用いられる⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-sem-is-used-pejoratively-or-as⟧。接頭辞*shi-*は「本当の」「真の」「大なる」を意味し、また再帰相を表す⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-prefix-shi-can-mean-real-true-great⟧。

text.en: The diminutive suffix *-po* appears as a fossilized element within certain nouns; the noun *menopoko* 'girl' is analyzed as consisting of *menoko* 'woman' with the diminutive suffix *-po* inserted ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-noun-menopoko-girl-is-analyzed-as-consisting⟧.
text.ja: 指小接尾辞*-po*は特定の名詞の内部に化石化した要素として現れる；名詞*menopoko*「娘」は、*menoko*「女」に指小接尾辞*-po*が付いた名詞と分析される⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-noun-menopoko-girl-is-analyzed-as-consisting⟧。

text.en: The diminutive suffix *-po* is derived from the independent noun *po* 'child/son' in Shizunai Ainu ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-diminutive-suffix-po-is-derived-from-the⟧.
text.ja: 静内アイヌ語において、指小辞*-po*は独立名詞*po*「子供・息子」に由来する⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-diminutive-suffix-po-is-derived-from-the⟧。

text.en: The suffix *-po* originated as a diminutive meaning 'child', used for 'small thing' or 'cute thing' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-suffix-po-originated-as-a-diminutive-suffix⟧. The form *ak-po* is permitted only in epic poetry, whereas in colloquial Horobetsu speech attaching *-po* to terms for loved ones conveys the meaning 'deceased' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-suffix-po-originated-as-a-diminutive-suffix⟧.
text.ja: 接尾辞*-po*は元来「子」に発した指小辞で「小さいもの」「可愛いもの」等を意味する⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-suffix-po-originated-as-a-diminutive-suffix⟧。*ak-po*という形は叙事詩にのみ許される一方、幌別地方の口語では*-po*を親しいものに付けると「死んだ（故人）」の意になる⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-suffix-po-originated-as-a-diminutive-suffix⟧。

text.en: The element *mo* 'small' occurs in the meaning 'small' only as a constituent in a limited set of words, such as *mo-rew* 'small curve' ⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-element-mo-small-occurs-in-the-meaning⟧.
text.ja: *mo*を「小さい」の意味で使うのは、*mo-rew*「小さな曲線」のような限られた語の構成要素としてだけである⟦claim:nominal/nominal-derivation-diminutive-augmentative--the-element-mo-small-occurs-in-the-meaning⟧。
